notes: Source diffs are relative to the accepted base. Only the final source remains in src/.
Raw objdiff objects below are parsed tool output, not authored measurements.
Experiments with candidate_externalized=false retain the compiler-local 72.0f symbol. Their strict scores include that unequal relocation target; no mismatch is hidden or treated as a match.
Early experiments have raw objdiff output but no separately captured build log; later experiments include both.
The accepted base source is byte-identical to the preserved attempt source at 47d60f04322f8b11fd5d641ecf6083e9baba93f3.

The overlapping storage-view and inline-helper experiments failed to preserve the count reload with an interior pointer. Wide induction with u16 uses and an explicit timestamp conditional improved the candidate.
Original per-experiment output files were consolidated into this bundle; the historical -o paths in the captured commands identify their provenance.
